mapper.sql: ics17_user_request_id AS user_request_id, ics17_company_id AS company_id, ics17_person_id AS person_id, TO_CHAR(ics17_reg_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS reg_date, ics17_law_title AS law_title, ics17_law_content AS law_content, ics17_submit_to AS submit_to, ics17_related_law AS related_law, ics17_report_cycle AS report_cycle, ics17_result AS result, ics17_note AS note, ics17_state_cd AS state_code, TO_CHAR(ics17_close_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS close_date, ics17_confirm_yn AS confirm_yn
mapper.select: SELECT , f_cdnm('AfterStateCode', ics17_state_cd, ics17_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS state_name , f_emp_kor_nm(ics17_person_id) AS person_name , f_get_company_nm(ics17_company_id) AS company_name FROM ics17_user_request WHERE ics17_user_request_id = #{userRequestId}
mapper.update: UPDATE ics17_user_request SET ics17_confirm_yn = #{req.confirmYn}, ics17_state_cd = #{req.stateCode}, ics17_close_date = #{req.closeDate}::date, ics17_result = #{req.result}, ics17_note = #{req.note} WHERE ics17_user_request_id = #{userRequestId}
